scripts.test:engine: npm run build:engine && playwright test --config playwright.engine.config.ts
scripts.test:selection: vitest run tests/surface-query.test.ts tests/surface-buffers.test.ts tests/surface-layout.test.ts tests/surface-coverage.test.ts tests/surface-pipelines.test.ts tests/surface-scratch-pool.test.ts tests/selection-map-cache.test.ts tests/selection-map-snapshot.test.ts tests/opacity-selection-maps.test.ts
